questions.question_text: Find the number of factors of 720.
questions.explanation: 720 = 2⁴·3²·5, so the number of factors is (4+1)(2+1)(1+1) = 5·3·2 = 30.
questions.source: Simplification 02_.pdf, PDF page 8; exam/year not stated per item (PYQ status unverified)

questions.question_text: Find the number of even factors of 2³ × 3⁴ × 5⁶.
questions.explanation: An even factor needs at least one 2: 3 choices for the power of 2, then 5 and 7 choices for 3 and 5, giving 3·5·7 = 105.

questions.question_text: Find the number of even factors of 842.
questions.explanation: 842 = 2·421; an even factor must contain one factor of 2, and 421 is prime, giving 1·2 = 2 even factors.

questions.question_text: Find the value of 15% of 480 + 25% of 240.
questions.explanation: 15% of 480 = 72 and 25% of 240 = 60, so the sum is 132.

questions.question_text: Find the total number of factors of 360.
questions.explanation: 360 = 2³·3²·5, so the number of factors is 4·3·2 = 24.

questions.question_text: Find the number of prime factors in 12³ (counting repetition).
questions.explanation: 12³ = (2²·3)³ = 2⁶·3³, so the number of prime factors is 6 + 3 = 9.
